title: Gratin Courgettes with Mediterranean Flair
description: A delicious and flavorful keto side dish made with courgettes, roasted garlic, and a hint of Mediterranean herbs.
instructions: Slice the courgettes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
In a large skillet, heat the light olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced courgettes and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the roasted garlic and Mediterranean seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the courgettes are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the courgettes with grated Parmesan cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the gratin courgettes hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
